title: Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra basins
quote: Himalayan rivers are antecedent and perennial: fed by rain + snowmelt

boxes.title: Indus system
items: Mansarovar rivers: **Indus, Sutlej, Brahmaputra, Karnali**; Ganga, Yamuna, Chenab do not
Between Ladakh & Zaskar → turns south at **Nanga Parbat** → Arabian Sea near **Karachi**

boxes.title: Course of the Ganga
steps: Padma + Brahmaputra + Meghna → Bay of Bengal as **Meghna**

boxes.title: Ganga tributaries
head: Bank
Rivers & confluence
rows: ==**Yamuna**== (longest, westernmost), **Son** (Amarkantak; near Patna), Tons, **Damodar** (rift valley → Hugli)
Right: **Chambal**, Sindh, **Betwa**, Ken; Left: Tons, Hindon

boxes.title: Brahmaputra facts
items: Right bank: **Subansiri, Kameng** (Jia Bharali), **Manas, Sankosh**, Teesta
**Teesta**: Tso Lhamo; joins in Bangladesh; Rangeet = largest tributary

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: **Indus Waters Treaty 1960**: eastern (==Ravi, Beas, Sutlej==) → India; western (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab) → Pakistan
